metadata.title: VisorFans — Monetization platform for content creators
metadata.description: We serve digital creators (models, influencers and artists) and their subscribers. We sell monthly subscriptions and digital credit packs through our web portal.

protectedMedia.obscured: Content hidden while the window is inactive.

protectedMediaDemo.title: ProtectedMedia — demo
protectedMediaDemo.intro: Development page with placeholder assets. Try it: right-click, try to drag, switch tabs or click outside the window.
protectedMediaDemo.disclaimer: This is a deterrent, not a security control: no web page can stop an OS screenshot, a screen recorder or an external camera. The real protection is server-side (per-viewer forensic watermarking + audit trail); this layer only makes casual capture more awkward and keeps the trace code in frame.
protectedMediaDemo.videoNote: No real source — poster only. In production the overlay receives the traceCode that GET /api/content/:id/serve returns alongside the signed URL.

models.heading: Model approvals
models.intro: Models start pending and cannot upload or take subscribers until approved.
models.approvePrompt: Approve {name}? They will be able to upload content and accept subscribers immediately.
models.rejectPrompt: Reject {name}? The reason is recorded and shown to them.

users.heading: Users
users.suspendPrompt: Suspend {email}? They will be signed out at their next refresh and cannot log in until reinstated.
users.reinstatePrompt: Reinstate {email}? They will be able to log in again immediately.

payouts.heading: Payouts
payouts.intro: Weekly runs are triggered by the cron job on Mondays. A manual run pays every model above the threshold now.
payouts.runPrompt: Start a payout run now? Every model above the threshold with a payout email will be paid through the provider. This is recorded under your account.
payouts.runDone: Run finished: {processed} paid, {skipped} skipped, {failed} failed, {total} in total.

reports.heading: Content reports
reports.intro: Reports filed by viewers. Resolving records your decision; unpublishing goes through the same toggle a model uses.
reports.resolvePrompt: Resolve this report with “{action}”? This cannot be undone.
